sections.kicker: Prepared for Casa Baba by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Casa Baba already has its punchy line. It is in small type.
sections.keep: "No needles, no machines." Five words that set you apart from most clinics.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: Your clearest message sits below the booking line.
pins.why: Four words say what you do and how, faster than any paragraph.
pins.how: Make it the headline and let everything else support it.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: People read the method name and miss the message.

pins.quote: The Face Up™ Method is a hands-on sculpting treatment designed to release tension and highlight your natural features.
pins.what: The opening explains a method other practitioners also offer.
pins.why: The reason to book Casa Baba is Barbora, and she appears later.
pins.how: Lead with her hands and her studio, then name the method.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: You compete with every Face Up practitioner on price and distance.

pins.what: The bio lists two methods and four body areas.
pins.why: A list is the opposite of punchy.
pins.how: Use the same four words as the site, and nothing else.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Followers cannot say in one line what you do.

sections.intro: You said something is off and you want a clear, punchy message, after trying different ways to say it. You already wrote it. Here is where.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Casa Baba's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Aesop, from another category. It says less and lets the hands and materials speak.
